verses.original: וְאֶת־ בֵּיתוֹ֙ בָּנָ֣ה שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה שְׁלֹ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה שָׁנָ֑ה וַיְכַ֖ל אֶת־ כָּל־ בֵּיתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- bê·ṯōw bā·nāh šə·lō·mōh šə·lōš ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh way·ḵal ’eṯ- kāl- bê·ṯōw
verses.literal: Solomon however took thirteen . . . years to complete the construction of his entire palace
verses.literalPt: Salomão edificou a sua casa, levando treze anos para concluí-la.

verses.original: וַיִּ֜בֶן אֶת־ בֵּ֣ית׀ יַ֣עַר הַלְּבָנ֗וֹן מֵאָ֨ה אַמָּ֤ה אָרְכּוֹ֙ וַחֲמִשִּׁ֤ים אַמָּה֙ רָחְבּ֔וֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אַמָּ֖ה קוֹמָת֑וֹ עַ֗ל אַרְבָּעָה֙ טוּרֵי֙ עַמּוּדֵ֣י אֲרָזִ֔ים וּכְרֻת֥וֹת אֲרָזִ֖ים עַל־ הָעַמּוּדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḇen ’eṯ- bêṯ ya·‘ar hal·lə·ḇā·nō·wn mê·’āh ’am·māh ’ā·rə·kōw wa·ḥă·miš·šîm ’am·māh rā·ḥə·bōw ū·šə·lō·šîm ’am·māh qō·w·mā·ṯōw ‘al ’ar·bā·‘āh ṭū·rê ‘am·mū·ḏê ’ă·rā·zîm ū·ḵə·ru·ṯō·wṯ ’ă·rā·zîm ‘al- hā·‘am·mū·ḏîm
verses.literal: He built the House of the Forest of Lebanon a hundred cubits long fifty cubits wide and thirty cubits high with four rows of cedar pillars supporting . . . the cedar beams
verses.literalPt: Edificou a casa do bosque do Líbano, a qual tinha cem cúbitos de comprido, cinquenta de largo e trinta de alto, repousando sobre quatro ordens de colunas de cedro, com vigas de cedro sobre as colunas.

verses.original: וְסָפֻ֣ן בָּאֶ֗רֶז מִמַּ֙עַל֙ עַל־ הַצְּלָעֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ הָֽעַמּוּדִ֔ים אַרְבָּעִ֖ים וַחֲמִשָּׁ֑ה חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר הַטּֽוּר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·sā·p̄un bā·’e·rez mim·ma·‘al ‘al- haṣ·ṣə·lā·‘ōṯ ’ă·šer ‘al- hā·‘am·mū·ḏîm ’ar·bā·‘îm wa·ḥă·miš·šāh ḥă·miš·šāh ‘ā·śār haṭ·ṭūr
verses.literal: The house was roofed with cedar above the beams that rested on the pillars forty-five beams . . . fifteen . . . per row
verses.literalPt: Por cima, a cobertura era de cedro, abrangendo as câmaras laterais em número de quarenta e cinco, quinze em cada ordem, as quais repousavam sobre as colunas.

verses.original: וּשְׁקֻפִ֖ים שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה טוּרִ֑ים וּמֶחֱזָ֥ה אֶל־ מֶחֱזָ֖ה שָׁלֹ֥שׁ פְּעָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·qu·p̄îm šə·lō·šāh ṭū·rîm ū·me·ḥĕ·zāh ’el- me·ḥĕ·zāh šā·lōš pə·‘ā·mîm
verses.literal: There were three rows of high windows facing one another . . . . . . in three tiers
verses.literalPt: Havia entradas para a luz em três ordens, e janela correspondia a janela em três fileiras.

verses.original: וְכָל־ הַפְּתָחִ֥ים וְהַמְּזוּז֖וֹת רְבֻעִ֣ים שָׁ֑קֶף וּמ֧וּל מֶחֱזָ֛ה אֶל־ מֶחֱזָ֖ה שָׁלֹ֥שׁ פְּעָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl hap·pə·ṯā·ḥîm wə·ham·mə·zū·zō·wṯ rə·ḇu·‘îm šā·qep̄ ū·mūl me·ḥĕ·zāh ’el- me·ḥĕ·zāh šā·lōš pə·‘ā·mîm
verses.literal: All the doorways had rectangular frames with the openings facing one another . . . in three tiers
verses.literalPt: Todas as portas e ombreiras eram de vigas em quadro; e janela correspondia a janela em três fileiras.

verses.original: וְאֵ֨ת אוּלָ֤ם הָֽעַמּוּדִים֙ עָשָׂ֔ה חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים אַמָּה֙ אָרְכּ֔וֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אַמָּ֖ה רָחְבּ֑וֹ וְאוּלָם֙ עַל־ פְּנֵיהֶ֔ם וְעַמֻּדִ֥ים וְעָ֖ב עַל־ פְּנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ ’ū·lām hā·‘am·mū·ḏîm ‘ā·śāh ḥă·miš·šîm ’am·māh ’ā·rə·kōw ū·šə·lō·šîm ’am·māh rā·ḥə·bōw wə·’ū·lām ‘al- pə·nê·hem wə·‘am·mu·ḏîm wə·‘āḇ ‘al- pə·nê·hem
verses.literal: Solomon made his colonnade . . . fifty cubits long and thirty cubits wide with a portico in front of it . . . and a canopy with pillars in front of the portico
verses.literalPt: O pórtico, que tinha cinquenta cúbitos de comprido, e trinta de largo, fê-lo de colunas; e, defronte delas, outro pórtico com colunas e degraus à entrada.

verses.original: וְאוּלָ֤ם הַכִּסֵּא֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִשְׁפָּט־ שָׁ֔ם אֻלָ֥ם הַמִּשְׁפָּ֖ט עָשָׂ֑ה וְסָפ֣וּן בָּאֶ֔רֶז מֵהַקַּרְקַ֖ע עַד־ הַקַּרְקָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ū·lām hak·kis·sê ’ă·šer yiš·pāṭ- šām ’u·lām ham·miš·pāṭ ‘ā·śāh wə·sā·p̄ūn bā·’e·rez mê·haq·qar·qa‘ ‘aḏ- haq·qar·qā‘
verses.literal: In addition, he built a hall for the throne the Hall of Justice where he was to judge . . . It was paneled with cedar from floor to ceiling
verses.literalPt: Fez também o Pórtico do Trono, onde julgasse, a saber, o Pórtico do Juízo, o qual era coberto de cedro desde o soalho ao teto.

verses.original: וּבֵיתוֹ֩ אֲשֶׁר־ יֵ֨שֶׁב שָׁ֜ם חָצֵ֣ר הָאַחֶ֗רֶת מִבֵּית֙ לָֽאוּלָ֔ם כַּמַּֽעֲשֶׂ֥ה הַזֶּ֖ה הָיָ֑ה וּבַ֜יִת יַעֲשֶׂ֤ה לְבַת־ פַּרְעֹה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָקַ֣ח שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה כָּאוּלָ֖ם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇê·ṯōw ’ă·šer- yê·šeḇ šām ḥā·ṣêr hā·’a·ḥe·reṯ mib·bêṯ lā·’ū·lām kam·ma·‘ă·śeh haz·zeh hā·yāh ū·ḇa·yiṯ ya·‘ă·śeh lə·ḇaṯ- par·‘ōh ’ă·šer lā·qaḥ šə·lō·mōh kā·’ū·lām haz·zeh
verses.literal: And the palace where Solomon would live . . . set further back . . . was of similar construction He also made a palace like this hall for Pharaoh’s daughter whom he had married
verses.literalPt: A sua casa de morada, em outro átrio por dentro do pórtico, era de obra semelhante. Fez também para a filha de Faraó (a qual Salomão tomara por mulher) uma casa semelhante a este pórtico.

verses.original: כָּל־ אֵ֜לֶּה אֲבָנִ֤ים יְקָרֹת֙ כְּמִדֹּ֣ת גָּזִ֔ית מְגֹרָר֥וֹת בַּמְּגֵרָ֖ה מִבַּ֣יִת וּמִח֑וּץ וּמִמַּסָּד֙ עַד־ הַטְּפָח֔וֹת וּמִח֖וּץ עַד־ הֶחָצֵ֥ר הַגְּדוֹלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ’êl·leh ’ă·ḇā·nîm yə·qā·rōṯ kə·mid·dōṯ gā·zîṯ mə·ḡō·rā·rō·wṯ bam·mə·ḡê·rāh mib·ba·yiṯ ū·mi·ḥūṣ ū·mim·mas·sāḏ ‘aḏ- haṭ·ṭə·p̄ā·ḥō·wṯ ū·mi·ḥūṣ ‘aḏ- he·ḥā·ṣêr hag·gə·ḏō·w·lāh
verses.literal: All these buildings were constructed with costly stones cut to size and trimmed with saws inside and out from the foundation to the eaves and from the outside to the great courtyard
verses.literalPt: Todos esses edifícios, por dentro e por fora, eram de pedra de preço, a saber, de pedras cortadas sob medida, serradas à serra desde os fundamentos até o cimo das paredes, e por fora até o grande átrio.

verses.original: וּמְיֻסָּ֕ד אֲבָנִ֥ים יְקָר֖וֹת אֲבָנִ֣ים גְּדֹל֑וֹת אַבְנֵי֙ עֶ֣שֶׂר אַמּ֔וֹת וְאַבְנֵ֖י שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה אַמּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mə·yus·sāḏ ’ă·ḇā·nîm yə·qā·rō·wṯ ’ă·ḇā·nîm gə·ḏō·lō·wṯ ’aḇ·nê ‘e·śer ’am·mō·wṯ wə·’aḇ·nê šə·mō·neh ’am·mō·wṯ
verses.literal: The foundations were laid with large . . . costly . . . stones some ten cubits long and some eight cubits long
verses.literalPt: Os fundamentos eram de pedras de preço, pedras grandes, de dez e de oito cúbitos,

verses.original: וּמִלְמַ֗עְלָה אֲבָנִ֧ים יְקָר֛וֹת כְּמִדּ֥וֹת גָּזִ֖ית וָאָֽרֶז׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mil·ma‘·lāh ’ă·ḇā·nîm yə·qā·rō·wṯ kə·mid·dō·wṯ gā·zîṯ wā·’ā·rez
verses.literal: Above these were costly stones cut to size and cedar beams
verses.literalPt: e, por cima delas, pedras de preço, cortadas sob medida, e madeira de cedro.

verses.original: וְחָצֵ֨ר הַגְּדוֹלָ֜ה סָבִ֗יב שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ טוּרִ֣ים גָּזִ֔ית וְט֖וּר כְּרֻתֹ֣ת אֲרָזִ֑ים וְלַחֲצַ֧ר בֵּית־ יְהוָ֛ה הַפְּנִימִ֖ית וּלְאֻלָ֥ם הַבָּֽיִת׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥā·ṣêr hag·gə·ḏō·w·lāh sā·ḇîḇ šə·lō·šāh ṭū·rîm gā·zîṯ wə·ṭūr kə·ru·ṯōṯ ’ă·rā·zîm wə·la·ḥă·ṣar bêṯ- Yah·weh hap·pə·nî·mîṯ ū·lə·’u·lām hab·bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: The great courtyard was surrounded by three rows of dressed stone and a row of trimmed cedar beams as were the inner courtyard and portico of the house of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Ao redor do grande átrio, havia três ordens de pedras cortadas e uma ordem de vigas de cedro, tais como o átrio interior da Casa de Jeová e o pórtico da casa.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַח֙ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה וַיִּקַּ֥ח אֶת־ חִירָ֖ם מִצֹּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ ham·me·leḵ šə·lō·mōh way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- ḥî·rām miṣ·ṣōr
verses.literal: Now King Solomon sent to bring Huram from Tyre
verses.literalPt: Enviou o rei Salomão e mandou trazer de Tiro a Hirão,

verses.original: בֶּן־ אִשָּׁה֩ אַלְמָנָ֨ה ה֜וּא מִמַּטֵּ֣ה נַפְתָּלִ֗י וְאָבִ֣יו אִישׁ־ צֹרִי֮ חֹרֵ֣שׁ נְחֹשֶׁת֒ וַ֠יִּמָּלֵא אֶת־ הַחָכְמָ֤ה וְאֶת־ הַתְּבוּנָה֙ וְאֶת־ הַדַּ֔עַת לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת כָּל־ מְלָאכָ֖ה בַּנְּחֹ֑שֶׁת וַיָּבוֹא֙ אֶל־ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה וַיַּ֖עַשׂ אֶת־ כָּל־ מְלַאכְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ’iš·šāh ’al·mā·nāh hū mim·maṭ·ṭêh nap̄·tā·lî wə·’ā·ḇîw ’îš- ṣō·rî ḥō·rêš nə·ḥō·šeṯ way·yim·mā·lê ’eṯ- ha·ḥā·ḵə·māh wə·’eṯ- hat·tə·ḇū·nāh wə·’eṯ- had·da·‘aṯ la·‘ă·śō·wṯ kāl- mə·lā·ḵāh ban·nə·ḥō·šeṯ way·yā·ḇō·w ’el- ham·me·leḵ šə·lō·mōh way·ya·‘aś ’eṯ- kāl- mə·laḵ·tōw
verses.literal: He was the son of a widow . . . from the tribe of Naphtali and his father was a man of Tyre a craftsman in bronze Huram had great skill understanding and knowledge . . . for every kind of bronze work So he came to King Solomon and carried out all his work
verses.literalPt: que era filho duma mulher viúva da tribo de Naftali, e dum homem de Tiro, que trabalhava em bronze. Hirão era cheio de sabedoria, de entendimento e de ciência para fazer toda sorte de obras de bronze. Veio ter com o rei Salomão e executou todas as suas obras.

verses.original: וַיָּ֛צַר אֶת־ שְׁנֵ֥י הָעַמּוּדִ֖ים נְחֹ֑שֶׁת שְׁמֹנֶ֨ה עֶשְׂרֵ֜ה אַמָּ֗ה קוֹמַת֙ הָעַמּ֣וּד הָאֶחָ֔ד וְחוּט֙ שְׁתֵּים־ עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה אַמָּ֔ה יָסֹ֖ב אֶת־ הָעַמּ֥וּד הַשֵּׁנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ṣar ’eṯ- šə·nê hā·‘am·mū·ḏîm nə·ḥō·šeṯ šə·mō·neh ‘eś·rêh ’am·māh qō·w·maṯ hā·‘am·mūḏ hā·’e·ḥāḏ wə·ḥūṭ šə·têm- ‘eś·rêh ’am·māh yā·sōḇ ’eṯ- hā·‘am·mūḏ haš·šê·nî
verses.literal: He cast two pillars of bronze each eighteen . . . cubits high and twelve . . . cubits in circumference . . . - . . .
verses.literalPt: Pois formou as duas colunas de bronze, tendo cada uma delas a altura de dezoito cúbitos, e uma circunferência que correspondia a uma linha de doze cúbitos.

verses.original: וּשְׁתֵּ֨י כֹתָרֹ֜ת עָשָׂ֗ה לָתֵ֛ת עַל־ רָאשֵׁ֥י הָֽעַמּוּדִ֖ים מֻצַ֣ק נְחֹ֑שֶׁת חָמֵ֣שׁ אַמּ֗וֹת קוֹמַת֙ הַכֹּתֶ֣רֶת הָאֶחָ֔ת וְחָמֵ֣שׁ אַמּ֔וֹת קוֹמַ֖ת הַכֹּתֶ֥רֶת הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·tê ḵō·ṯā·rōṯ ‘ā·śāh lā·ṯêṯ ‘al- rā·šê hā·‘am·mū·ḏîm mu·ṣaq nə·ḥō·šeṯ ḥā·mêš ’am·mō·wṯ qō·w·maṯ hak·kō·ṯe·reṯ hā·’e·ḥāṯ wə·ḥā·mêš ’am·mō·wṯ qō·w·maṯ hak·kō·ṯe·reṯ haš·šê·nîṯ
verses.literal: He also made two capitals of cast bronze to set on top of the pillars each capital - five cubits high
verses.literalPt: Fez também dois capitéis de bronze fundido para os pôr sobre o alto das colunas; um capitel tinha cinco cúbitos de altura, e o outro capitel tinha também cinco cúbitos de altura.

verses.original: שְׂבָכִ֞ים מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה שְׂבָכָ֗ה גְּדִלִים֙ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה שַׁרְשְׁר֔וֹת לַכֹּ֣תָרֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ רֹ֣אשׁ הָעַמּוּדִ֑ים שִׁבְעָה֙ לַכֹּתֶ֣רֶת הָאֶחָ֔ת וְשִׁבְעָ֖ה לַכֹּתֶ֥רֶת הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: śə·ḇā·ḵîm ma·‘ă·śêh śə·ḇā·ḵāh gə·ḏi·lîm ma·‘ă·śêh šar·šə·rō·wṯ lak·kō·ṯā·rōṯ ’ă·šer ‘al- rōš hā·‘am·mū·ḏîm šiḇ·‘āh lak·kō·ṯe·reṯ hā·’e·ḥāṯ wə·šiḇ·‘āh lak·kō·ṯe·reṯ haš·šê·nîṯ
verses.literal: For the capitals on top of the pillars he made a network of lattice with wreaths of chainwork seven for each capital -
verses.literalPt: Havia redes de malhas e grinaldas de cadeias, para os capitéis que estavam sobre o alto das colunas: sete para um capitel e sete para o outro.

verses.original: וַיַּ֖עַשׂ אֶת־ הָעַמּוּדִ֑ים וּשְׁנֵי֩ טוּרִ֨ים סָבִ֜יב עַל־ הַשְּׂבָכָ֣ה הָאֶחָ֗ת לְכַסּ֤וֹת אֶת־ הַכֹּֽתָרֹת֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־ רֹ֣אשׁ הָֽרִמֹּנִ֔ים וְכֵ֣ן עָשָׂ֔ה לַכֹּתֶ֖רֶת הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś ’eṯ- hā·‘am·mū·ḏîm ū·šə·nê ṭū·rîm sā·ḇîḇ ‘al- haś·śə·ḇā·ḵāh hā·’e·ḥāṯ lə·ḵas·sō·wṯ ’eṯ- hak·kō·ṯā·rōṯ ’ă·šer ‘al- rōš hā·rim·mō·nîm wə·ḵên ‘ā·śāh lak·kō·ṯe·reṯ haš·šê·nîṯ
verses.literal: Likewise, he made the pillars with two rows of pomegranates around . . . each grating to cover each capital atop the pillars -
verses.literalPt: Fez as colunas, e havia duas ordens de romãs ao redor, por cima duma rede para cobrir os capitéis que estavam no alto das colunas; assim também fez para o outro capitel.

verses.original: וְכֹֽתָרֹ֗ת אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־ רֹ֣אשׁ הָעַמּוּדִ֔ים מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה שׁוּשַׁ֣ן בָּֽאוּלָ֑ם אַרְבַּ֖ע אַמּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵō·ṯā·rōṯ ’ă·šer ‘al- rōš hā·‘am·mū·ḏîm ma·‘ă·śêh šū·šan bā·’ū·lām ’ar·ba‘ ’am·mō·wṯ
verses.literal: And the capitals atop the pillars in the portico were shaped like lilies four cubits high
verses.literalPt: Os capitéis que estavam no alto das colunas, no pórtico na parte que figuravam lírios, tinham quatro cúbitos.

verses.original: וְכֹתָרֹ֗ת עַל־ שְׁנֵי֙ הָֽעַמּוּדִ֔ים גַּם־ מִמַּ֙עַל֙ מִלְּעֻמַּ֣ת הַבֶּ֔טֶן אֲשֶׁ֖ר לְעֵ֣בֶר שְׂבָכָה וְהָרִמּוֹנִ֤ים מָאתַ֙יִם֙ טֻרִ֣ים סָבִ֔יב עַ֖ל הַכֹּתֶ֥רֶת הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵō·ṯā·rōṯ ‘al- šə·nê hā·‘am·mū·ḏîm gam- mim·ma·‘al mil·lə·‘um·maṯ hab·be·ṭen ’ă·šer lə·‘ê·ḇer śə·ḇå̄·ḵå̄h wə·hā·rim·mō·w·nîm mā·ṯa·yim ṭu·rîm sā·ḇîḇ ‘al hak·kō·ṯe·reṯ haš·šê·nîṯ
verses.literal: On the capitals of both pillars just above the rounded projection next to the network were the two hundred pomegranates in rows encircling . . . each capital . . .
verses.literalPt: Perto da parte globular, próximo à rede, os capitéis que estavam em cima sobre as duas colunas, tinham duzentas romãs, dispostas em ordens ao redor sobre um e outro capitel.

verses.original: וַיָּ֙קֶם֙ אֶת־ הָֽעַמֻּדִ֔ים לְאֻלָ֖ם הַֽהֵיכָ֑ל וַיָּ֜קֶם אֶת־ הָעַמּ֣וּד הַיְמָנִ֗י וַיִּקְרָ֤א אֶת־ שְׁמוֹ֙ יָכִ֔ין וַיָּ֙קֶם֙ אֶת־ הָעַמּ֣וּד הַשְּׂמָאלִ֔י וַיִּקְרָ֥א אֶת־ שְׁמ֖וֹ בֹּֽעַז׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qem ’eṯ- hā·‘am·mu·ḏîm lə·’u·lām ha·hê·ḵāl way·yā·qem ’eṯ- hā·‘am·mūḏ hay·mā·nî way·yiq·rā ’eṯ- šə·mōw yā·ḵîn way·yā·qem ’eṯ- hā·‘am·mūḏ haś·śə·mā·lî way·yiq·rā ’eṯ- šə·mōw bō·‘az
verses.literal: Thus he set up the pillars at the portico of the temple The pillar - to the south he named - Jachin and the pillar - to the north he named - Boaz
verses.literalPt: Levantou as colunas no pórtico do templo; tendo levantado a coluna direita, pôs-lhe o nome de Jaquim; e, tendo levantado a coluna esquerda, pôs-lhe o nome de Boaz.

verses.original: וְעַ֛ל רֹ֥אשׁ הָעַמּוּדִ֖ים מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה שׁוֹשָׁ֑ן וַתִּתֹּ֖ם מְלֶ֥אכֶת הָעַמּוּדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al rōš hā·‘am·mū·ḏîm ma·‘ă·śêh šō·wō·šān wat·tit·tōm mə·le·ḵeṯ hā·‘am·mū·ḏîm
verses.literal: And the tops of the pillars were shaped like lilies So the work of the pillars was completed
verses.literalPt: O trabalho figurando lírios estava em cima das colunas. Assim se acabou a obra das colunas.

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת־ הַיָּ֖ם מוּצָ֑ק עֶ֣שֶׂר בָּ֠אַמָּה מִשְּׂפָת֨וֹ עַד־ שְׂפָת֜וֹ עָגֹ֣ל׀ סָבִ֗יב וְחָמֵ֤שׁ בָּֽאַמָּה֙ קוֹמָת֔וֹ וּקְוֵה שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה יָסֹ֥ב אֹת֖וֹ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś ’eṯ- hay·yām mū·ṣāq ‘e·śer bā·’am·māh miś·śə·p̄ā·ṯōw ‘aḏ- śə·p̄ā·ṯōw ‘ā·ḡōl sā·ḇîḇ wə·ḥā·mêš bā·’am·māh qō·w·mā·ṯōw ū·qə·wēh šə·lō·šîm bā·’am·māh yā·sōḇ ’ō·ṯōw sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: He also made the Sea of cast metal It was circular in shape . . . measuring ten cubits from rim to rim five cubits in height and thirty cubits in circumference . . .
verses.literalPt: Fez também o mar de fundição de dez cúbitos duma borda à outra, perfeitamente redondo, e de altura de cinco cúbitos; a sua circunferência correspondia a uma linha de trinta cúbitos.

verses.original: וּפְקָעִים֩ מִתַּ֨חַת לִשְׂפָת֤וֹ׀ סָבִיב֙ סֹבְבִ֣ים אֹת֔וֹ עֶ֚שֶׂר בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה מַקִּפִ֥ים אֶת־ הַיָּ֖ם סָבִ֑יב שְׁנֵ֤י טוּרִים֙ הַפְּקָעִ֔ים יְצֻקִ֖ים בִּיצֻקָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄ə·qā·‘îm mit·ta·ḥaṯ liś·p̄ā·ṯōw sā·ḇîḇ sō·ḇə·ḇîm ’ō·ṯōw ‘e·śer bā·’am·māh maq·qi·p̄îm ’eṯ- hay·yām sā·ḇîḇ šə·nê ṭū·rîm hap·pə·qā·‘îm yə·ṣu·qîm bî·ṣu·qā·ṯōw
verses.literal: Below the rim ornamental buds encircled . . . it ten per cubit all the way around the Sea cast in two rows as a part of the Sea
verses.literalPt: Por baixo da sua borda, havia saliências em número de dez por cúbito, que cingiam o mar; as saliências estavam em duas ordens e fundidas, quando o mar foi fundido.

verses.original: עֹמֵ֞ד עַל־ שְׁנֵ֧י עָשָׂ֣ר בָּקָ֗ר שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה פֹנִ֣ים׀ צָפ֡וֹנָה וּשְׁלֹשָׁה֩ פֹנִ֨ים׀ יָ֜מָּה וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה׀ פֹּנִ֣ים נֶ֗גְבָּה וּשְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פֹּנִ֣ים מִזְרָ֔חָה וְהַיָּ֥ם עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם מִלְמָ֑עְלָה וְכָל־ אֲחֹֽרֵיהֶ֖ם בָּֽיְתָה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·mêḏ ‘al- šə·nê ‘ā·śār bā·qār šə·lō·šāh p̄ō·nîm ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh ū·šə·lō·šāh p̄ō·nîm yām·māh ū·šə·lō·šāh pō·nîm neḡ·bāh ū·šə·lō·šāh pō·nîm miz·rā·ḥāh wə·hay·yām ‘ă·lê·hem mil·mā·‘ə·lāh wə·ḵāl ’ă·ḥō·rê·hem bā·yə·ṯāh
verses.literal: The Sea stood on twelve . . . oxen three facing north three facing west three facing south and three facing east The Sea rested on them . . . with all their hindquarters toward the center
verses.literalPt: Firmava-se sobre doze bois, três dos quais olhavam para o norte; três, para o ocidente; três, para o sul; e três, para o oriente. O mar lhes ficava por cima, e todas as partes posteriores dos seus corpos estavam para a banda de dentro.

verses.original: וְעָבְי֣וֹ טֶ֔פַח וּשְׂפָת֛וֹ כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה שְׂפַת־ כּ֖וֹס פֶּ֣רַח שׁוֹשָׁ֑ן אַלְפַּ֥יִם בַּ֖ת יָכִֽיל׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·ḇə·yōw ṭe·p̄aḥ ū·śə·p̄ā·ṯōw kə·ma·‘ă·śêh śə·p̄aṯ- kō·ws pe·raḥ šō·wō·šān ’al·pa·yim baṯ yā·ḵîl
verses.literal: It was a handbreadth thick and its rim was fashioned like the brim of a cup like a lily blossom It could hold two thousand baths
verses.literalPt: A grossura do mar era dum palmo; e a sua borda foi feita como a dum copo, como a flor dum lírio. Ele levava dois mil batos.

verses.original: וַיַּ֧עַשׂ אֶת־ הַמְּכֹנ֛וֹת עֶ֖שֶׂר נְחֹ֑שֶׁת אַרְבַּ֣ע בָּאַמָּ֗ה אֹ֚רֶךְ הַמְּכוֹנָ֣ה הָֽאֶחָ֔ת וְאַרְבַּ֤ע בָּֽאַמָּה֙ רָחְבָּ֔הּ וְשָׁלֹ֥שׁ בָּאַמָּ֖ה קוֹמָתָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś ’eṯ- ham·mə·ḵō·nō·wṯ ‘e·śer nə·ḥō·šeṯ ’ar·ba‘ bā·’am·māh ’ō·reḵ ham·mə·ḵō·w·nāh hā·’e·ḥāṯ wə·’ar·ba‘ bā·’am·māh rā·ḥə·bāh wə·šā·lōš bā·’am·māh qō·w·mā·ṯāh
verses.literal: In addition, he made ten movable stands of bronze each four cubits long four cubits wide and three cubits high
verses.literalPt: Fez também dez bases de bronze; cada uma tinha quatro cúbitos de comprido, quatro de largo e três de alto.

verses.original: וְזֶ֛ה מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה הַמְּכוֹנָ֖ה מִסְגְּרֹ֣ת לָהֶ֑ם וּמִסְגְּרֹ֖ת בֵּ֥ין הַשְׁלַבִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zeh ma·‘ă·śêh ham·mə·ḵō·w·nāh mis·gə·rōṯ lā·hem ū·mis·gə·rōṯ bên haš·lab·bîm
verses.literal: This was the design of the stands They had side panels . . . . . . attached to uprights
verses.literalPt: A obra das bases era a seguinte: tinham elas almofadas entre as junturas;

verses.original: וְעַֽל־ הַמִּסְגְּר֞וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ בֵּ֣ין הַשְׁלַבִּ֗ים אֲרָי֤וֹת׀ בָּקָר֙ וּכְרוּבִ֔ים וְעַל־ הַשְׁלַבִּ֖ים כֵּ֣ן מִמָּ֑עַל וּמִתַּ֙חַת֙ לַאֲרָי֣וֹת וְלַבָּקָ֔ר לֹי֖וֹת מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה מוֹרָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al- ham·mis·gə·rō·wṯ ’ă·šer bên haš·lab·bîm ’ă·rā·yō·wṯ bā·qār ū·ḵə·rū·ḇîm wə·‘al- haš·lab·bîm kên mim·mā·‘al ū·mit·ta·ḥaṯ la·’ă·rā·yō·wṯ wə·lab·bā·qār lō·yō·wṯ ma·‘ă·śêh mō·w·rāḏ
verses.literal: and on the panels between the uprights were lions oxen and cherubim On the uprights was a pedestal above and below the lions and oxen were wreaths of beveled work
verses.literalPt: sobre as almofadas que estavam entre as junturas havia leões, bois e querubins; nas junturas da parte de cima havia uma projeção, e debaixo dos leões e dos bois havia festões pendentes.

verses.original: וְאַרְבָּעָה֩ אוֹפַנֵּ֨י נְחֹ֜שֶׁת לַמְּכוֹנָ֤ה הָֽאַחַת֙ וְסַרְנֵ֣י נְחֹ֔שֶׁת וְאַרְבָּעָ֥ה פַעֲמֹתָ֖יו כְּתֵפֹ֣ת לָהֶ֑ם מִתַּ֤חַת לַכִּיֹּר֙ הַכְּתֵפֹ֣ת יְצֻק֔וֹת מֵעֵ֥בֶר אִ֖ישׁ לֹיֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ar·bā·‘āh ’ō·w·p̄an·nê nə·ḥō·šeṯ lam·mə·ḵō·w·nāh hā·’a·ḥaṯ wə·sar·nê nə·ḥō·šeṯ wə·’ar·bā·‘āh p̄a·‘ă·mō·ṯāw kə·ṯê·p̄ōṯ lā·hem mit·ta·ḥaṯ lak·kî·yōr hak·kə·ṯê·p̄ōṯ yə·ṣu·qō·wṯ mê·‘ê·ḇer ’îš lō·yō·wṯ
verses.literal: Each stand had four bronze wheels with bronze axles and a basin resting on four supports with wreaths at each side
verses.literalPt: Cada base tinha quatro rodas de bronze e eixos de bronze; os seus quatro pés tinham uns como ombrinhos fundidos, que, tendo festões ao lado, estavam debaixo do lavatório.

verses.original: וּ֠פִיהוּ מִבֵּ֨ית לַכֹּתֶ֤רֶת וָמַ֙עְלָה֙ בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה וּפִ֙יהָ֙ עָגֹ֣ל מַעֲשֵׂה־ כֵ֔ן אַמָּ֖ה וַחֲצִ֣י הָֽאַמָּ֑ה וְגַם־ עַל־ פִּ֙יהָ֙ מִקְלָע֔וֹת וּמִסְגְּרֹתֵיהֶ֥ם מְרֻבָּע֖וֹת לֹ֥א עֲגֻלּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄î·hū mib·bêṯ lak·kō·ṯe·reṯ wā·ma‘·lāh bā·’am·māh ū·p̄î·hā ‘ā·ḡōl ma·‘ă·śêh- ḵên ’am·māh wa·ḥă·ṣî hā·’am·māh wə·ḡam- ‘al- pî·hā miq·lā·‘ō·wṯ ū·mis·gə·rō·ṯê·hem mə·rub·bā·‘ō·wṯ lō ‘ă·ḡul·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: The opening to each stand inside the crown at the top was one cubit deep with a round opening like the design of a pedestal a cubit and a half wide And around its opening were engravings but the panels of the stands were square not round
verses.literalPt: A abertura na parte superior da base que recebia o capitel era dum cúbito; e a abertura no capitel era redonda, como a obra dum pedestal, e dum cúbito e meio, tendo a sua borda entalhes, cujas almofadas eram quadradas, não redondas.

verses.original: וְאַרְבַּ֣עַת הָאֽוֹפַנִּ֗ים לְמִתַּ֙חַת֙ לַֽמִּסְגְּר֔וֹת וִיד֥וֹת הָאֽוֹפַנִּ֖ים בַּמְּכוֹנָ֑ה וְקוֹמַת֙ הָאוֹפַ֣ן הָאֶחָ֔ד אַמָּ֖ה וַחֲצִ֥י הָאַמָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ar·ba·‘aṯ hā·’ō·w·p̄an·nîm lə·mit·ta·ḥaṯ lam·mis·gə·rō·wṯ wî·ḏō·wṯ hā·’ō·w·p̄an·nîm bam·mə·ḵō·w·nāh wə·qō·w·maṯ hā·’ō·w·p̄an hā·’e·ḥāḏ ’am·māh wa·ḥă·ṣî hā·’am·māh
verses.literal: There were four wheels under the panels and the axles of the wheels were attached to the stand each wheel was a cubit and a half . . . in diameter
verses.literalPt: Debaixo das almofadas, estavam as quatro rodas, cujos eixos descansavam na base; cada roda tinha cúbito e meio de altura.

verses.original: וּמַֽעֲשֵׂה֙ הָא֣וֹפַנִּ֔ים כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֖ה אוֹפַ֣ן הַמֶּרְכָּבָ֑ה יְדוֹתָ֣ם וְגַבֵּיהֶ֗ם וְחִשֻּׁקֵיהֶ֛ם וְחִשֻּׁרֵיהֶ֖ם הַכֹּ֥ל מוּצָֽק׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ma·‘ă·śêh hā·’ō·w·p̄an·nîm kə·ma·‘ă·śêh ’ō·w·p̄an ham·mer·kā·ḇāh yə·ḏō·w·ṯām wə·ḡab·bê·hem wə·ḥiš·šu·qê·hem wə·ḥiš·šu·rê·hem hak·kōl mū·ṣāq
verses.literal: The wheels were made like chariot wheels their axles rims spokes and hubs were all of cast metal
verses.literalPt: As rodas eram como as dum carro; os seus eixos, as suas pinas, os seus raios e os seus cubos, tudo era fundido.

verses.original: וְאַרְבַּ֣ע כְּתֵפ֔וֹת אֶ֚ל אַרְבַּ֣ע פִּנּ֔וֹת הַמְּכֹנָ֖ה הָֽאֶחָ֑ת מִן־ הַמְּכֹנָ֖ה כְּתֵפֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ar·ba‘ kə·ṯê·p̄ō·wṯ ’el ’ar·ba‘ pin·nō·wṯ ham·mə·ḵō·nāh hā·’e·ḥāṯ min- ham·mə·ḵō·nāh kə·ṯê·p̄e·hā
verses.literal: Each stand had four handles one for each corner projecting from the stand
verses.literalPt: Aos quatro cantos de cada base, havia quatro ombrinhos que faziam parte das mesmas.

verses.original: וּבְרֹ֣אשׁ הַמְּכוֹנָ֗ה חֲצִ֧י הָאַמָּ֛ה קוֹמָ֖ה עָגֹ֣ל׀ סָבִ֑יב וְעַ֨ל רֹ֤אשׁ הַמְּכֹנָה֙ יְדֹתֶ֔יהָ וּמִסְגְּרֹתֶ֖יהָ מִמֶּֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·rōš ham·mə·ḵō·w·nāh ḥă·ṣî hā·’am·māh qō·w·māh ‘ā·ḡōl sā·ḇîḇ wə·‘al rōš ham·mə·ḵō·nāh yə·ḏō·ṯe·hā ū·mis·gə·rō·ṯe·hā mim·men·nāh
verses.literal: At the top of each stand was a circular band half a cubit high The supports and panels were cast as a unit with the top of the stand
verses.literalPt: No alto da base, havia um cinto redondo, que tinha meio cúbito de alto, e, sobre o topo da mesma, os seus esteios e as suas almofadas formavam uma só peça com ela.

verses.original: וַיְפַתַּ֤ח עַל־ הַלֻּחֹת֙ יְדֹתֶ֔יהָ וְעַל֙ וּמִסְגְּרֹתֶיהָ כְּרוּבִ֖ים אֲרָי֣וֹת וְתִמֹרֹ֑ת כְּמַֽעַר־ אִ֥ישׁ וְלֹי֖וֹת סָבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: way·p̄at·taḥ ‘al- hal·lu·ḥōṯ yə·ḏō·ṯe·hā wə·‘al ū·mis·gə·rō·ṯɛ·hå̄ kə·rū·ḇîm ’ă·rā·yō·wṯ wə·ṯi·mō·rōṯ kə·ma·‘ar- ’îš wə·lō·yō·wṯ sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: He engraved cherubim lions and palm trees on the surfaces of the supports and panels wherever each had space with wreaths all around
verses.literalPt: Nas placas dos seus esteios e nas almofadas, gravou querubins, leões e palmeiras, segundo o espaço que havia em cada uma, com festões ao redor.

verses.original: כָּזֹ֣את עָשָׂ֔ה אֵ֖ת עֶ֣שֶׂר הַמְּכֹנ֑וֹת מוּצָ֨ק אֶחָ֜ד מִדָּ֥ה אַחַ֛ת קֶ֥צֶב אֶחָ֖ד לְכֻלָּֽהְנָה׃ס
verses.transliteration: kā·zōṯ ‘ā·śāh ’êṯ ‘e·śer ham·mə·ḵō·nō·wṯ mū·ṣāq ’e·ḥāḏ mid·dāh ’a·ḥaṯ qe·ṣeḇ ’e·ḥāḏ lə·ḵul·lā·hə·nāh
verses.literal: In this way he made the ten stands each with the same casting . . . dimensions . . . and shape
verses.literalPt: Deste modo fez as dez bases; todas tinham a mesma fundição, a mesma medida e a mesma forma.

verses.original: וַיַּ֛עַשׂ עֲשָׂרָ֥ה כִיֹּר֖וֹת נְחֹ֑שֶׁת אַרְבָּעִ֨ים בַּ֜ת יָכִ֣יל׀ הַכִּיּ֣וֹר הָאֶחָ֗ד אַרְבַּ֤ע בָּֽאַמָּה֙ הַכִּיּ֣וֹר הָאֶחָ֔ד כִּיּ֤וֹר אֶחָד֙ עַל־ הַמְּכוֹנָ֣ה הָאַחַ֔ת לְעֶ֖שֶׂר הַמְּכֹנֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś ‘ă·śā·rāh ḵî·yō·rō·wṯ nə·ḥō·šeṯ ’ar·bā·‘îm baṯ yā·ḵîl hak·kî·yō·wr hā·’e·ḥāḏ ’ar·ba‘ bā·’am·māh hak·kî·yō·wr hā·’e·ḥāḏ kî·yō·wr ’e·ḥāḏ ‘al- ham·mə·ḵō·w·nāh hā·’a·ḥaṯ lə·‘e·śer ham·mə·ḵō·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: He also made ten bronze basins each holding forty baths and measuring four cubits across one basin for each of the ten . . . stands
verses.literalPt: Fez também dez lavatórios de bronze; cada lavatório levava quarenta batos e era de quatro cúbitos; e, sobre cada uma das dez bases, estava um lavatório.

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּן֙ אֶת־ הַמְּכֹנ֔וֹת חָמֵ֞שׁ עַל־ כֶּ֤תֶף הַבַּ֙יִת֙ מִיָּמִ֔ין וְחָמֵ֛שׁ עַל־ כֶּ֥תֶף הַבַּ֖יִת מִשְּׂמֹאל֑וֹ וְאֶת־ הַיָּ֗ם נָתַ֞ן מִכֶּ֨תֶף הַבַּ֧יִת הַיְמָנִ֛ית קֵ֖דְמָה מִמּ֥וּל נֶֽגֶב׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên ’eṯ- ham·mə·ḵō·nō·wṯ ḥā·mêš ‘al- ke·ṯep̄ hab·ba·yiṯ mî·yā·mîn wə·ḥā·mêš ‘al- ke·ṯep̄ hab·ba·yiṯ miś·śə·mō·lōw wə·’eṯ- hay·yām nā·ṯan mik·ke·ṯep̄ hab·ba·yiṯ hay·mā·nîṯ qê·ḏə·māh mim·mūl ne·ḡeḇ
verses.literal: He set five stands on the south side of the temple and five on the north - and he put the Sea on the south side at the southeast corner . . . . . . of the temple
verses.literalPt: Pôs as dez bases, cinco ao lado direito e cinco ao lado esquerdo da casa; e pôs o mar ao lado direito da casa, da banda oriental, na direção do sul.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ חִיר֔וֹם אֶת־ הַ֨כִּיֹּר֔וֹת וְאֶת־ הַיָּעִ֖ים וְאֶת־ הַמִּזְרָק֑וֹת וַיְכַ֣ל חִירָ֗ם לַֽעֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֛ה לַמֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś ḥî·rō·wm ’eṯ- hak·kî·yō·rō·wṯ wə·’eṯ- hay·yā·‘îm wə·’eṯ- ham·miz·rā·qō·wṯ way·ḵal ḥî·rām la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’eṯ- kāl- ham·mə·lā·ḵāh ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh lam·me·leḵ šə·lō·mōh bêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Additionally, Huram made the pots shovels and sprinkling bowls So Huram finished all the work that he had undertaken for King Solomon in the house of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Fez também Hirão os lavatórios, e as pás, e as bacias. Acabou Hirão de fazer toda a obra que executou para o rei Salomão na Casa de Jeová:

verses.original: עַמֻּדִ֣ים שְׁנַ֔יִם וְגֻלֹּ֧ת הַכֹּתָרֹ֛ת אֲשֶׁר־ עַל־ רֹ֥אשׁ הָֽעַמֻּדִ֖ים שְׁתָּ֑יִם וְהַשְּׂבָכ֣וֹת שְׁתַּ֔יִם לְכַסּ֗וֹת אֶת־ שְׁתֵּי֙ גֻּלֹּ֣ת הַכֹּֽתָרֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ רֹ֥אשׁ הָעַמּוּדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ‘am·mu·ḏîm šə·na·yim wə·ḡul·lōṯ hak·kō·ṯā·rōṯ ’ă·šer- ‘al- rōš hā·‘am·mu·ḏîm šə·tā·yim wə·haś·śə·ḇā·ḵō·wṯ šə·ta·yim lə·ḵas·sō·wṯ ’eṯ- šə·tê gul·lōṯ hak·kō·ṯā·rōṯ ’ă·šer ‘al- rōš hā·‘am·mū·ḏîm
verses.literal: the two pillars the two bowl-shaped capitals atop the pillars the two sets of network covering both bowls of the capitals - atop the pillars
verses.literalPt: as duas colunas, e os dois globos dos capitéis que estavam sobre o alto das colunas; as duas redes para cobrir os dois globos dos capitéis que estavam sobre o alto das colunas;

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הָרִמֹּנִ֛ים אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת לִשְׁתֵּ֣י הַשְּׂבָכ֑וֹת שְׁנֵֽי־ טוּרִ֤ים רִמֹּנִים֙ לַשְּׂבָכָ֣ה הָֽאֶחָ֔ת לְכַסּ֗וֹת אֶת־ שְׁתֵּי֙ גֻּלֹּ֣ת הַכֹּֽתָרֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הָעַמּוּדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- hā·rim·mō·nîm ’ar·ba‘ mê·’ō·wṯ liš·tê haś·śə·ḇā·ḵō·wṯ šə·nê- ṭū·rîm rim·mō·nîm laś·śə·ḇā·ḵāh hā·’e·ḥāṯ lə·ḵas·sō·wṯ ’eṯ- šə·tê gul·lōṯ hak·kō·ṯā·rōṯ ’ă·šer ‘al- pə·nê hā·‘am·mū·ḏîm
verses.literal: the four hundred pomegranates for the two sets of network (two rows of pomegranates for each network covering both the bowl-shaped capitals atop the pillars)
verses.literalPt: as quatrocentas romãs para cobrir as duas redes: duas ordens de romãs para cada rede, para cobrir os dois globos dos capitéis que estavam sobre as colunas;

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הַמְּכֹנ֖וֹת עָ֑שֶׂר וְאֶת־ הַכִּיֹּרֹ֥ת עֲשָׂרָ֖ה עַל־ הַמְּכֹנֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ham·mə·ḵō·nō·wṯ ‘ā·śer wə·’eṯ- hak·kî·yō·rōṯ ‘ă·śā·rāh ‘al- ham·mə·ḵō·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: the ten stands the ten basins on the stands
verses.literalPt: as dez bases e os dez lavatórios sobre as bases;

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הַיָּ֖ם הָאֶחָ֑ד וְאֶת־ הַבָּקָ֥ר שְׁנֵים־ עָשָׂ֖ר תַּ֥חַת הַיָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- hay·yām hā·’e·ḥāḏ wə·’eṯ- hab·bā·qār šə·nêm- ‘ā·śār ta·ḥaṯ hay·yām
verses.literal: the Sea . . . the twelve . . . oxen underneath the Sea
verses.literalPt: o mar com os doze bois por baixo;

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הַסִּיר֨וֹת וְאֶת־ הַיָּעִ֜ים וְאֶת־ הַמִּזְרָק֗וֹת וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ הַכֵּלִ֣ים הָאֹהֶל אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֥ה חִירָ֛ם לַמֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה נְחֹ֖שֶׁת מְמֹרָֽט׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- has·sî·rō·wṯ wə·’eṯ- hay·yā·‘îm wə·’eṯ- ham·miz·rā·qō·wṯ wə·’êṯ kāl- hak·kê·lîm hå̄·ʾō·hɛl ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh ḥî·rām lam·me·leḵ šə·lō·mōh bêṯ Yah·weh nə·ḥō·šeṯ mə·mō·rāṭ
verses.literal: and the pots shovels and sprinkling bowls All the articles . . . that Huram made for King Solomon in the house of the LORD were made of burnished bronze
verses.literalPt: os caldeirões, e as pás, e as bacias; todos esses vasos que fez Hirão para o rei Salomão na Casa de Jeová eram de bronze polido.

verses.original: בְּכִכַּ֤ר הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ יְצָקָ֣ם הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ בְּמַעֲבֵ֖ה הָאֲדָמָ֑ה בֵּ֥ין סֻכּ֖וֹת וּבֵ֥ין צָרְתָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḵik·kar hay·yar·dên yə·ṣā·qām ham·me·leḵ bə·ma·‘ă·ḇêh hā·’ă·ḏā·māh bên suk·kō·wṯ ū·ḇên ṣā·rə·ṯān
verses.literal: The king had them cast in clay molds in the plain of the Jordan between Succoth . . . and Zarethan
verses.literalPt: O rei os fez fundir na planície do Jordão, numa terra argilosa entre Sucote e Zaretã.

verses.original: וַיַּנַּ֤ח שְׁלֹמֹה֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַכֵּלִ֔ים מֵרֹ֖ב מְאֹ֣ד מְאֹ֑ד לֹ֥א נֶחְקַ֖ר מִשְׁקַ֥ל הַנְּחֹֽשֶׁת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yan·naḥ šə·lō·mōh ’eṯ- kāl- hak·kê·lîm mê·rōḇ mə·’ōḏ mə·’ōḏ lō neḥ·qar miš·qal han·nə·ḥō·šeṯ
verses.literal: Solomon left all these articles unweighed because there were so . . . many The weight of the bronze could not be determined
verses.literalPt: Deixou Salomão de pesar todos os vasos devido ao seu excessivo número; não se averiguou o peso de bronze.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה אֵ֚ת כָּל־ הַכֵּלִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה אֵ֚ת מִזְבַּ֣ח הַזָּהָ֔ב וְאֶת־ הַשֻּׁלְחָ֗ן אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָלָ֛יו לֶ֥חֶם הַפָּנִ֖ים זָהָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś šə·lō·mōh ’êṯ kāl- hak·kê·lîm ’ă·šer bêṯ Yah·weh ’êṯ miz·baḥ haz·zā·hāḇ wə·’eṯ- haš·šul·ḥān ’ă·šer ‘ā·lāw le·ḥem hap·pā·nîm zā·hāḇ
verses.literal: Solomon also made all the furnishings for the house of the LORD the golden altar the golden table on which was placed the Bread of the Presence
verses.literalPt: Fez Salomão todos os vasos que estavam na Casa de Jeová: o altar de ouro, e a mesa sobre a qual estavam os pães da proposição, de ouro;

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הַ֠מְּנֹרוֹת חָמֵ֨שׁ מִיָּמִ֜ין וְחָמֵ֧שׁ מִשְּׂמֹ֛אול לִפְנֵ֥י הַדְּבִ֖יר זָהָ֣ב סָג֑וּר וְהַפֶּ֧רַח וְהַנֵּרֹ֛ת וְהַמֶּלְקַחַ֖יִם זָהָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ham·mə·nō·rō·wṯ ḥā·mêš mî·yā·mîn wə·ḥā·mêš miś·śə·mō·wl lip̄·nê had·də·ḇîr zā·hāḇ sā·ḡūr wə·hap·pe·raḥ wə·han·nê·rōṯ wə·ham·mel·qa·ḥa·yim zā·hāḇ
verses.literal: the lampstands of pure gold in front of the inner sanctuary five on the right side and five on the left the gold flowers lamps and tongs
verses.literalPt: os candeeiros, cinco à direita e cinco à esquerda, diante do oráculo, de ouro puro; as flores, as lâmpadas e as tenazes, de ouro;

verses.original: וְ֠הַסִּפּוֹת וְהַֽמְזַמְּר֧וֹת וְהַמִּזְרָק֛וֹת וְהַכַּפּ֥וֹת וְהַמַּחְתּ֖וֹת זָהָ֣ב סָג֑וּר וְהַפֹּת֡וֹת לְדַלְתוֹת֩ הַבַּ֨יִת הַפְּנִימִ֜י לְקֹ֣דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֗ים לְדַלְתֵ֥י הַבַּ֛יִת לַהֵיכָ֖ל זָהָֽב׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·has·sip·pō·wṯ wə·ham·zam·mə·rō·wṯ wə·ham·miz·rā·qō·wṯ wə·hak·kap·pō·wṯ wə·ham·maḥ·tō·wṯ zā·hāḇ sā·ḡūr wə·hap·pō·ṯō·wṯ lə·ḏal·ṯō·wṯ hab·ba·yiṯ hap·pə·nî·mî lə·qō·ḏeš haq·qo·ḏā·šîm lə·ḏal·ṯê hab·ba·yiṯ la·hê·ḵāl zā·hāḇ
verses.literal: the pure gold basins wick trimmers sprinkling bowls ladles and censers and the gold hinges for the doors of the inner temple (that is, the Most Holy Place . . . as well as for the doors of the main hall of the temple
verses.literalPt: as taças, os apagadores, as bacias, as colheres e os braseiros, de ouro puro; e de ouro as dobradiças para as portas da casa interior, para as do Santo dos Santos e para as da casa, isto é, do templo.

verses.original: וַתִּשְׁלַם֙ כָּל־ הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֛ה הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וַיָּבֵ֨א שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה אֶת־ קָדְשֵׁ֣י׀ דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֗יו אֶת־ הַכֶּ֤סֶף וְאֶת־ הַזָּהָב֙ וְאֶת־ הַכֵּלִ֔ים נָתַ֕ן בְּאֹצְר֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wat·tiš·lam kāl- ham·mə·lā·ḵāh ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh ham·me·leḵ šə·lō·mōh bêṯ Yah·weh way·yā·ḇê šə·lō·mōh ’eṯ- qā·ḏə·šê dā·wiḏ ’ā·ḇîw ’eṯ- hak·ke·sep̄ wə·’eṯ- haz·zā·hāḇ wə·’eṯ- hak·kê·lîm nā·ṯan bə·’ō·ṣə·rō·wṯ bêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: So all the work that King Solomon had performed for the house of the LORD was completed Then Solomon brought in the items his father David had dedicated the silver the gold and the furnishings and he placed them in the treasuries of the house of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Assim se acabou toda a obra que o rei Salomão mandou fazer na Casa de Jeová. Salomão meteu nela as coisas que seu pai Davi tinha dedicado, a saber, a prata, e o ouro e os vasos, que depositou nos tesouros da Casa de Jeová.
